## estimate

Estimate Faq Migration. `GET /knowledge-base/faq-migration/estimate`

Preview a bulk migration: how many summaries, how many clusters, what it costs.

Read-only and side-effect free — it loads the tenant's ticket summaries and runs the same clustering the migration would, but makes no LLM call and writes nothing. This is what the "migrate history" button shows before the user commits.

```php
$result = $sendseven->faqMigration()->estimate();
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$limit` | `?int` | no | Only consider this many summaries (default: all, max 20000) |

Returns `FaqMigrationEstimate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/FAQ%20Migration/estimate_faq_migration_api_v1_knowledge_base_faq_migration_estimate_get)

## start

Start Faq Migration. `POST /knowledge-base/faq-migration/start`

Start (or preview) the bulk migration of ticket summaries into FAQ drafts.

dry_run=true is handled inline and never enqueues anything: it loads and clusters the summaries and returns what it would have processed. No Gemini call, no row written, no folder touched — so it cannot possibly change the tenant's knowledge base. Everything else publishes one migrate_ticket_summaries job; the worker processes a bounded number of clusters and re-enqueues itself until nothing is left, so this returns immediately and the UI polls /faq-migration/status.

```php
$result = $sendseven->faqMigration()->start();
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:manage`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$dryRun` | `?bool` | no | Preview only. Runs INLINE (no job is enqueued, no LLM call, no row written) and returns the clustering it would have processed |
| `$limit` | `?int` | no | Cap on summaries read in one pass (default: all, max 20000) |
| `$maxClusters` | `?int` | no | Clusters processed per worker message (default 40). Higher values risk the 600s worker message timeout; the job re-enqueues itself either way, so raising this buys nothing but risk |
| `$minClusterSize` | `?int` | no | Override the tenant's faq_min_cluster_size for this run — the floor at which a cluster counts as recurring rather than one-off |
| `$includeSingletons` | `?bool` | no | Process one-off cases too. Set false for the cheap high-value pass: singletons dominate the cluster count and the cost, and are refused almost every time |
| `$retireFolderWhenDone` | `?bool` | no | Hide the legacy 'Ticket Summaries' KB folder once nothing is left to migrate. A visible change to the tenant's KB tree, so opt-in. Ignored for dry_run |
| `$force` | `?bool` | no | Start even though a migration appears to be in flight, overriding the 409. Only for a run known to be dead — two live chains double-bill the tenant and race on the same summaries |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FaqMigrationStart`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/FAQ%20Migration/start_faq_migration_api_v1_knowledge_base_faq_migration_start_post)

## getStatus

Get Faq Migration Status. `GET /knowledge-base/faq-migration/status`

Progress of the bulk migration, from what it has actually persisted.

Poll-safe: counts are read back from the rows the migration wrote, with no clustering and no LLM call.

```php
$result = $sendseven->faqMigration()->getStatus();
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$includeEstimate` | `?bool` | no | Also run a fresh clustering pass (same work as /faq-migration/estimate). Expensive — never poll with this on |

Returns `FaqMigrationStatus`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/FAQ%20Migration/get_faq_migration_status_api_v1_knowledge_base_faq_migration_status_get)
